requirement:
As a customer, I want to place an order to buy a toy so that I can receive it at home.
Acceptance criteria:
- Customer can order at most 5 units per toy
- Out-of-stock toys cannot be ordered

As a customer, I want to log in to my account with my password so that my personal data stays private.
Acceptance criteria:
- Account is locked after 5 failed login attempts
As a user, I want to upload a profile photo so that others recognise me.
